answer: Sealed-bid admission auction: each epoch seats only 10 new wallets, all paying the 10th-highest bid, burned, with a 2 POA floor. An honest user running wallet zephyr pays 2 POA once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 seats, which is 100 epochs of slots and at least 2,000 POA burned. Splitting bids across many funders fails because the price rises 10% after each full epoch. Every seat must echo a random 90-second ping within 20 epochs or its reward is forfeited, and a wharf of idle bots fails it. Limit: a rich attacker can still buy seats.
